Hi there!

I'm a dietary ethical vegan. I made the switch from ovo-vegetarian last September after having followed that diet for almost 15 years. I had trouble cutting down on eggs because of health reasons, but have been taking B12 supplements and it seems to have made everything OK. I had been only eating free-range eggs, but I felt like that wasn't enough.

As I mentioned, I had a bad case of B12 deficiency when I switched to vegan. This, in tandem with high levels of physical activity caused a lot of stress on my body. I ended up getting a series of ear/nose/throat infections that lasted a bit over a month due to becoming immunocompromised. The B12 pills fixed that and I haven't been sick since. B12 is important for neuron upkeep and the formation of blood cells, among other things so if any new vegans are out there: make sure you're not B12 deficient!

My favourite dish is a vegan version of a Peruvian dish called Lomo Saltado. It's usually strips of tenderloin stir fried with aji amarillo, tomatoes, red peppers, red onions and garnished with cilantro, all laid out over fries. I make it with tofu marinated in vegetable stock and various spices and I sauté it in red wine/soy sauce. My Peruvian family claims that it's actually tastier than the original.
